title: 2024 3rd Year Welcome & Farewell Party | Ritsumeikan University Social Intelligence Laboratory

summary.place: Place: Seafood Izakaya Hananomai JR Ibaraki Station Store

overview: We held a welcome party for the third-year students who were newly assigned from the fall semester, and a party to thank the seniors who graduated in the spring semester! The party was held at Hana no Mai, a seafood izakaya near JR Ibaraki Station. As we all moved around the seats in a large room, we deepened our friendships with the third-year students and exchanged final farewells with the graduating students. The food was centered around fresh seafood, and a wide variety of alcohol was also available, and everyone enjoyed the meal! We hope to further deepen our unity in preparation for activities in the fall semester! Thank you to all the graduates for your hard work on your graduation theses!
